improvements.rationale: The homepage currently lacks optimized meta tags, which hurts search rankings and makes social shares appear generic. A compelling meta description (under 160 characters) improves click-through rates from Google. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure the site displays professionally when shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—critical for B2B audiences. The copy emphasizes key differentiators (Claude-powered, voice chat, free trial) without fabricating claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace to streamline your operations. Try three searches free — no credit card required."
improvements.rationale: This headline clearly names the product and its core function, building immediate brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while emphasizing the risk-free trial offer. 'No credit card required' removes friction and increases trial conversions. Copy is concise, benefit-driven, and avoids unverifiable claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing Gideon. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30 percent with an annual plan. As a member, you'll unlock unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own dedicated workspace.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model—what happens at the paywall. By clearly explaining the transition and immediately reinforcing value and pricing, it reduces uncertainty and supports conversion at the critical decision moment.
